jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: polished painted doll-racing animation atlas. Reference image is the EXACT doll identity, outfit, vinyl face and anatomical proportions to preserve. Draw this same doll facing RIGHT in three-quarter view in ALL twelve poses, with cool, composed balance. Transparent background. Output EXACTLY THREE columns by FOUR rows of equal SQUARE cells, portrait3:4. Uniform head/body size in every cell, generous safe transparent padding (at least10% cell on all sides) and clean gutters. ROW1 skating glide: push off trailing foot low on wheels, feet together gliding, alternate foot pushes low. Classic WHITE BOOT four-wheel quad skates, wheels #5a3a86. Both feet stay LOW near baseline, no running knees or lifted back skates. Slight forward lean, loose balancing arms. ROW2 on same skates: stand balanced feet together; thrust one hand forward RIGHT pushing/throwing; fall backward LEFT with arms up and both skates swinging forward RIGHT. ROW3 compact pogo bounce: compressed knees and spring; extended knees and spring; slightly tucked airborne-ready (do not raise whole doll within cell). Both hands grip handlebar at chest, both feet on pegs. Pogo design identical in every cell: RED vertical pole, SILVER coil spring near bottom, BLACK grips and foot pegs, BLACK rubber bottom tip; keep original doll footwear from reference on pogo. Tip centered below doll on baseline; keep pogo compact so doll retains full anatomical scale. ROW4 on pogo: balancing upright gripping handle; one hand off handle thrust forward RIGHT pushing/throwing; fall backward LEFT off stick which tips away toward RIGHT (entire stick visible). Keep original clothes and original footwear in all pogo cells; only skating cells have white skates. Feet/skate wheels or rubber tip bottom align same ground baseline. Keep full hair, hands, wheels and tips within every cell, no overlap. Entire doll visible, no floor, shadows, text, labels or grid. Exactly twelve figures, no extra poses or props.
